productionOutcomeCases.title: Learning-enabled part-mass control across virgin and recycled PP batch transitions
productionOutcomeCases.process: Injection moulding; plate mould; cavity-pressure NMPC + part-mass control
productionOutcomeCases.material: Virgin PP plus two post-consumer-recycled PP batches
productionOutcomeCases.baseline_or_problem: Material transitions create cycle-to-cycle property changes that normally require process adjustment.
productionOutcomeCases.diagnosis_or_mechanism: Material-property drift changes pressure/flow response; model/controller adapts after each cycle.
productionOutcomeCases.intervention: Learning-enabled nonlinear model-predictive cavity-pressure control plus cycle-variant part-mass reference generator.
productionOutcomeCases.verified_outcome: 50 uninterrupted production cycles across material transitions with mean part-mass deviation 0.21% from reference.
productionOutcomeCases.limitations: Research production setup rather than long-term commercial plant deployment.

productionOutcomeCases.title: Adaptive pressure control for five recycled polypropylene blends
productionOutcomeCases.process: Pressure-controlled injection moulding with in-mould sensing
productionOutcomeCases.material: Five recycled PP blends spanning flow-property variation
productionOutcomeCases.baseline_or_problem: Secondary-feedstock rheology varies and can destabilize pressure, part weight and mechanical response.
productionOutcomeCases.diagnosis_or_mechanism: Melt-viscosity variation changes cavity fill/pressure response.
productionOutcomeCases.intervention: Closed-loop pressure control with automated viscosity adjustment based on in-mould pressure.
productionOutcomeCases.verified_outcome: Reduced in-mould pressure variation; molded-part weight variation reported below 0.04% across blends and mechanical/weight coefficient of variation under 5%.

productionOutcomeCases.title: DMAIC recovery of injection-moulding OEE at PT. XYZ
productionOutcomeCases.baseline_or_problem: Low OEE driven by idle time, setup/cleaning, downtime, maintenance and operating discipline.
productionOutcomeCases.diagnosis_or_mechanism: FMEA/5-Why analysis identified critical operating losses.
productionOutcomeCases.intervention: Standardized setup, preventive/autonomous maintenance, operator training, control plans and audit/check sheets.
productionOutcomeCases.verified_outcome: Reported OEE improvement from 59.61% to 87.63%, exceeding the 85% project target after the improvement/control period.
productionOutcomeCases.limitations: Case-study reporting; not a randomized intervention.

productionOutcomeCases.title: 14-month automotive injection-moulding OEE improvement
productionOutcomeCases.process: Hydraulic plastic injection moulding of an automotive component
productionOutcomeCases.baseline_or_problem: Frequent downtime and slower-than-ideal cycles limited utilization.
productionOutcomeCases.diagnosis_or_mechanism: Mechanical downtime and cycle-time losses dominated early performance.
productionOutcomeCases.intervention: Structured improvement initiatives implemented in late 2025.
productionOutcomeCases.verified_outcome: OEE rose from about 53.9% in January 2025 to 95.8% in December 2025; December quality was 99.99% with 1 reject in 11,535 parts.
productionOutcomeCases.limitations: Article links improvement to interventions but is observational.

productionOutcomeCases.title: Six Sigma defect/cost improvement in plastic injection moulding
productionOutcomeCases.diagnosis_or_mechanism: DMAIC isolated and addressed root causes for the target defect.
productionOutcomeCases.intervention: Integrated Six Sigma DMAIC improvement program.
productionOutcomeCases.verified_outcome: Sigma level increased from 4.06 to 4.5 and cost of poor quality fell 45%; rejection rate reported as significantly reduced.
productionOutcomeCases.limitations: Applied to one defect and one part; full underlying dataset is not openly bundled.

productionOutcomeCases.title: Gas-mark reduction on housing-panel mould at PT. Patco
productionOutcomeCases.material: STYRON Polystyrene 438 mentioned in full-text source
productionOutcomeCases.baseline_or_problem: Gas marks; FMEA assigned gas mark the highest RPN (75).
productionOutcomeCases.diagnosis_or_mechanism: Dirty mould and insufficient gas venting.
productionOutcomeCases.intervention: Mould maintenance plus creation of gas vents in cavity/ejector-pin areas (reported 3 mm wide, 0.03 mm deep for the described case).
productionOutcomeCases.verified_outcome: Gas-mark defects were reported as greatly reduced after vent creation.
productionOutcomeCases.limitations: Outcome is qualitative rather than a published numeric before/after defect rate.

productionOutcomeCases.title: Cavity-pressure diagnosis of short-shot and burn-mark failures
productionOutcomeCases.process: Injection moulding with multiple in-cavity pressure sensors
productionOutcomeCases.baseline_or_problem: Short shots and burn marks require distinguishing fill/transfer/tooling mechanisms.
productionOutcomeCases.diagnosis_or_mechanism: Pressure-profile shape and asymmetric filling reveal process/tool information and support failure origin identification.
productionOutcomeCases.intervention: Use pressure-profile monitoring and sensor-position-aware interpretation for process optimization.
productionOutcomeCases.verified_outcome: Study demonstrated failure diagnosis and correlation of measured pressure signatures with observed defects/simulation.
productionOutcomeCases.limitations: Diagnostic study rather than a long-run commercial corrective-action record.

productionOutcomeCases.title: Online diagnosis of injection-machine non-return-valve wear
productionOutcomeCases.process: Injection moulding machine NRV health monitoring
productionOutcomeCases.baseline_or_problem: NRV wear is hidden and traditionally requires machine disassembly to diagnose.
productionOutcomeCases.diagnosis_or_mechanism: Wear alters time-domain signal features during injection.
productionOutcomeCases.intervention: SAE feature extraction + XGBoost fault diagnosis integrated into machine control.
productionOutcomeCases.verified_outcome: Study reports diagnosis across five NRV states, with SAE-XGBoost accuracy of 99.6% versus 97.5% for XGBoost alone.
productionOutcomeCases.limitations: Controlled fault-state experiment; 160 molded products reported.

productionOutcomeCases.title: Five-machine industrial fault-diagnostics learning loop
productionOutcomeCases.process: Plastic injection moulding across five work systems
productionOutcomeCases.baseline_or_problem: Very rare faults make single-machine datasets too imbalanced for reliable diagnosis.
productionOutcomeCases.diagnosis_or_mechanism: Pooling information across similar systems improves learning under extreme class imbalance.
productionOutcomeCases.verified_outcome: Approximately two million cycles over six months; fault ratio 1:1484; study reported improved models and transfer/generalisation to another work system.
productionOutcomeCases.limitations: Raw industrial dataset is not openly released.

productionOutcomeCases.title: Industrial road-lens quality classes from an ENGEL injection line
productionOutcomeCases.baseline_or_problem: Need online discrimination among waste, merely acceptable, target-quality and inefficient-overquality production.
productionOutcomeCases.diagnosis_or_mechanism: Process state is related to measured lens uniformity and resource use.
productionOutcomeCases.intervention: Use MES variables for quality prediction/control decisions.
productionOutcomeCases.verified_outcome: 1,446 labeled production cycles represented four operational quality classes: waste, acceptable, target and inefficient.
productionOutcomeCases.limitations: Quality label is application-specific photometric uniformity, not a universal moulding quality metric.
